recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future best-practice content should use the existing invariant/narrative mechanism and include meaningful explanation text, including exceptions where known, rather than changing FHIR-15977 infrastructure.
issue_request: FHIR-15977 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested best-practice recommendations using a specific extension on invariants, spreadsheet/tooling support, informative marking, explanatory text including known exceptions, and a summary view across the specification.
initial_application: The issue was applied in the SVN-imported history by 5193d38922ed2de51aa37976aab8dd8fba0ade14, GF#15977 - add support for best practice invariants, with follow-up build fix d3d530e80fb52900c8832c3a6dddbba499069956 for SVN revision 13914. Earlier history had already introduced the ElementDefinition best-practice extension and spreadsheet support.
additional_context: Current core source contains the informative best-practices page, documentation and hierarchy links, conformance-rule guidance for guideline/best-practice constraints, and active best-practice constraints with explanation text. The extension definitions now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, where elementdefinition-bestpractice and elementdefinition-bestpractice-explanation remain active. Zulip implementation discussion confirms best practices are informative, rendered separately, and only enforced by validators when requested.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core source plus the Extension Pack definitions already convey the requested mechanism and produce the current rendered best-practice summary.
